lasting: The Emperor died and the Cities went on taxing. Some things outlive anyone.
Since Tengu died every lord thinks he is next in line. They are all wrong.

rumours.name: Esata
fresh: Esata is dead. The Stone Golem. An outlander did it, they say, two days back.

The Stone Golem is dead. Somebody out there is very good, or very lucky.
Esata, dead. Bayan will have to find someone else to blame for everything.
lasting: Esata died and the Kingdom did not. The Shek are harder to kill than their queens.
They still tell the story of who killed the Stone Golem. It grows every time.
Since Esata fell the Shek fight like they have something to prove. They always did.

rumours.name: Longen
fresh: Longen is dead. Somebody got past the guards at Stack. Two days ago, they say.

Longen is gone. Every slave in the Cities heard it before the lords did.
They say Longen is dead. Nobody I know is wearing black.
lasting: Longen died and somebody else took the desk. The Guild always has a spare.
Old news, Longen. The ledgers did not even pause.

lasting: Lady Tsugi died and the house went to a cousin. Same walls, same whips.

lasting: Lord Inaba died and the Cities did not miss a single tax day.
